_readme: Reality Audit JSON import template (REALITY_AUDIT_PLAN / NEXT_GOAL C2).
Copy this structure; one element of `samples` per place. All names below are placeholders — use fictional demo places unless you hold lawful real material with provenance.
Flat CSV alternative: import_template.csv (same fields, one row per fragment; the tool ingests both via --csv detection by file suffix).

Known enums: animal_scope in dog|cat|ordinary_pet|service_dog|other; action in enter|pass_through|stay|walk|off_leash|ground_contact|ride_elevator|ride_transport|use_facility|dine|stay_overnight; effect in allowed|prohibited|conditional; rule_layer in LEGAL|REGULATORY_GUIDANCE|OPERATOR_POLICY|TEMPORARY_POLICY; source_type per docs (statute_or_regulation|government_service|official_operator_policy|onsite_signage|certified_verifier|ordinary_user|external_web_reference|imported_dataset).
Anything outside these sets is reported back as a schema-gap candidate — that is the point of the audit.
